title: Sysoy bell (Rostov Kremlin)
status_note: Hangs in the Rostov cathedral belfry (museum-reserve).

place.label: Cathedral belfry (Sobornaya zvonnitsa), Rostov Kremlin
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

mass_note: 2,000 poods per the museum; converted at 16.38 kg per pood (our conversion)

tiers.everyday: Sysoy is the biggest bell of the famous Rostov Kremlin belfry, cast in 1688 and weighing about 2,000 poods (roughly 33 tonnes).
tiers.student: The Rostov Kremlin museum gives Sysoy as cast in 1688 by Flor Terentyev at 2,000 poods (about 32.8 t by our conversion). The same belfry holds the earlier Polyeleiny (1,000 poods) and Lebed (500 poods) bells cast by the Andreev masters.
